<!-- Provide a clear description of the content -->

The largest change is consolidating the JET config into a single module defined in `JetConfig.jl`. 

Bumps many tolerance bounds in the tests. Some of these I am particularly unsure of. I left inline review comments pointing them out. 

Some of the more complicated stencil benchmarks are now about 15% slower from using newer Julia versions

~~Fixes a GPU bug from using 1.12 from String vs SubString~~



non trivial changes for reviewers:
- `ambiguous_constructor_types`
- the top bounds I pointed out
- the hack to make CUDA profiler not segfault
- JET infrastructure consolidation
- it is not possible to use the latest JET version and have snoop compile work...
